security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown prose, reference paths, or workflow labels rather than executable behavior. Five instructions do execute package or installed-skill commands; additionally, the skill mandates mutable CLI and workflow updates that can change a project or execute retrieved code without an explicit confirmation gate.

remediation.issue: Mutable CLI upgrades are applied automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before applying an upgrade, pin the target version, and present the planned package.json diff before changing files.

remediation.issue: Workflow updates retrieve and execute unpinned content.
remediation.suggestion: Use versioned workflow releases with integrity verification, and require confirmation before installation or update.

remediation.issue: Installed skill scripts are executed by path.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the installed skill provenance and version before running its scripts, and validate all project-path arguments.

content.value_statement: Video requests can require different workflows, assets, and review steps. This skill routes the request, confirms a production brief, and loads the appropriate HyperFrames capabilities.
actual_capabilities: Routes video, animation, slideshow, caption, and Remotion-port requests to named HyperFrames workflows.
Resumes existing projects by identifying briefs, storyboards, and project configuration files.
Collects a confirmed brief with message, route, assets, customization choices, and review preferences.
Adapts Figma URLs through the dedicated Figma workflow and preserves asset provenance guidance.
Offers relevant production capabilities such as website capture, captions, audio analysis, and media staging.
Loads domain skills for composition, animation, creative direction, media, CLI operations, and registry blocks.
limitations: It is a router and briefing layer, not a complete video renderer by itself.
Rendering, publishing, and media generation depend on installed HyperFrames workflows and their available tools.
Website capture and Figma import require access to the supplied source and may be restricted by permissions.
The skill may run package and workflow update commands unless the user limits command execution.

use_cases.title: Plan a product launch video
use_cases.description: Turn a website or product brief into a routed launch-video workflow with a confirmed message and destination.

use_cases.title: Explain a pull request visually
use_cases.description: Route a GitHub pull request to a technical video workflow and size the explanation from the change scope.

use_cases.title: Resume a video project
use_cases.description: Inspect existing brief and project files, then continue with the appropriate validation, preview, or render operation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a video project
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second product video for our new analytics dashboard. The audience is operations managers.

prompt_templates.title: Build from a website
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a launch video from https://example.com. Capture the site look and prepare a storyboard review.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a code change
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a developer-focused video explaining GitHub PR owner/repo#123. Recommend the length from the change size.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and validate
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume this HyperFrames project, check its current state, validate the composition, and tell me what must be approved before rendering.

output_examples.input: Create a short launch video from our product website.
output: Confirmed brief: product message, audience, destination, and capture preference
Next step: install the selected workflow and prepare the storyboard review

output_examples.input: Explain this pull request for developers.
output: Suggested length based on the pull request change size
Brief questions for angle, audience, destination, and review mode

best_practices: Provide the audience, message, destination, and available source material before production starts.
Review the confirmed brief and storyboard before approving a full render.
Approve package upgrades and workflow updates only after reviewing their version and project impact.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to replace a specific edit or validation request with a new discovery interview.
Do not assume a website, Figma file, or pull request alone determines the intended story.
Do not allow mutable workflow updates without checking the version and source.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes HyperFrames video requests, gathers a production brief, and loads the skills needed for the selected workflow.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies existing briefs, storyboards, and project files, then performs the requested project operation.

faq.question: Can I create a video from a website?
faq.answer: Yes. It can route website-based requests to the product launch workflow and offer site capture when appropriate.

faq.question: Can I use a Figma design?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs Figma URLs to the dedicated Figma workflow for assets, tokens, components, and storyboard frames.

faq.question: Does it render a video by itself?
faq.answer: No. It selects and prepares downstream HyperFrames workflows that perform production and rendering.

faq.question: Does it install or update software?
faq.answer: The instructions include CLI and workflow update commands. Review and approve these commands before they change a project.
